arguments.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: exactly ONE single 1024x1024 transparent RGBA game animation frame, attack W 06 of 12, never a sheet or multiple poses.
Reference 1: exact E identity. Reference 2: exact W identity. Reference 3: approved primary painted style/material only, do not copy UI. Reference 4: previous approved same-direction animation frame; preserve its camera, body root, scale, original footprint and identity, advance only the specified pose.
Preserve Shuangtuan marten unchanged: pearl-grey furry round head and compact body; exactly TWO rounded dark grey ears, amber eyes, marten muzzle, exactly FOUR grey paws, ONE large pale-jade broad curled silky tail, ivory/celadon gold-scroll scarf, small white flowers, crescent gold-jade bead dewdrop pendant with small red knot attached to the same scarf knot. No fox, no pointed ears, no weapon, no second tail. Original scarf ribbons remain clothing.
W camera locked: true three-quarter BACK facing screen UP-LEFT. Show rear of rounded head, back, hindquarters, rear paws/heels. No front-facing chest and no face turned toward viewer. LF = animal's own LEFT forepaw is near-side, RF = far-side. Attack only with LF. This is independent rear-view drawing, never mirrored E.
Only pose change for this frame: Body begins pushing forward IN PLACE. LEFT forepaw LF begins extending forward from chest, about one third extension. RIGHT RF and both hind paws remain support. Head and shoulders start rising from crouch.
Keep stable footprint, same camera and scale, centered full-body sprite; lowest planted paw target around y942 of 1024, body root stable. Four paws with clear anatomically continuous shoulder-elbow-paw chains; natural animal posture, no human gestures. Natural local weight transfer, not whole-image translation and not a moving or walking cycle. All ears, tail, whiskers and scarf ends contained within frame with margin. Clean bright rounded Chinese Taoist chibi high-detail hand-painted fur, warm ivory cloth, soft jade and delicate gold, matching identity references closely. Fully transparent alpha background, no floor, no shadow platform, no scenery, no UI/text, no panel, no motion blur or extraneous effects.
W support clarification: both hind paws bear weight naturally; hocks bend forward toward upper-left target and toes point upper-left, heels toward viewer, avoid splayed or backwards feet. Show grounded toe contact and at most a subtle heel-pad glimpse, not two floating soles facing camera.
